name: Windows to Linux Commands
description: Complete Windows CMD to Linux Mint command reference - all categories
author: attila

ipconfig.description: Display IP address and interface info

ipconfig /all.description: Display full IP config (MAC, DHCP, DNS, gateway)

ipconfig /registerdns.description: Refresh DHCP and re-register DNS (requires sudo)

nslookup -type=MX hostname.description: Query DNS for MX record (mail server)

nslookup -type=NS hostname.description: Query DNS for NS record (name server)

nslookup -type=SOA hostname.description: Query DNS for SOA record (zone authority)

netstat -a.description: Display all connections and listening ports

netstat -an.description: Display all connections in numeric form

netstat -q.description: Display all connections, listening and non-listening

ping.description: Test network connectivity with ICMP echo

ping -a.description: Resolve IP to hostname while pinging

tracert -h maxhops.description: Trace route with max hop limit

tracert -w timeout.description: Trace route with custom timeout per hop

pathping -q count.description: Pathping with custom queries per hop

arp -a.description: Display ARP table (IP to MAC mappings)

arp -a ipaddress.description: Show ARP entry for specific IP

arp -d ipaddress.code: sudo ip neigh del 192.168.1.1 dev eth0

arp -s ip mac.code: sudo ip neigh add 192.168.1.1 lladdr AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF dev eth0

a1.code: sudo ip neigh replace 192.168.1.1 lladdr AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF dev eth0

nbtstat -A ipaddress.description: Show NetBIOS remote statistics by IP

a1.code: sudo ip route add 10.0.0.0/8 via 192.168.1.1 dev eth0
sudo ip route del default via 192.168.1.1

netsh interface show interface.description: List all network interfaces and status

netsh interface ip show config.description: Show IP configuration for all interfaces

netsh interface ip set address.code: sudo nmcli connection modify "conn" ipv4.addresses 192.168.1.100/24 ipv4.gateway 192.168.1.1
netsh interface ip set address.windows: netsh interface ip set address "Eth" static 192.168.1.100 255.255.255.0 192.168.1.1

a1.code: sudo nmcli connection modify "conn" ipv4.method auto (DHCP)

a2.code: sudo ip addr add 192.168.1.100/24 dev eth0

netsh interface ip set dns.windows: netsh interface ip set dns "Eth" static 8.8.8.8

netsh interface set interface disable.code: sudo ip link set eth0 down

netsh interface set interface enable.code: sudo ip link set eth0 up

netsh interface ipv6 show addresses.description: Show IPv6 addresses for all interfaces

a1.code: sudo ip neigh del 192.168.1.1 dev eth0

netsh wlan show profile key=clear.windows: netsh wlan show profile name="SSID" key=clear

netsh wlan add profile.code: nmcli connection import type wifi file profile.xml

netsh advfirewall show allprofiles.description: Show firewall status for all profiles (requires sudo)

netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state.description: Enable firewall for all profiles (requires sudo)
netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state.windows: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state on

netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state.description: Disable firewall for all profiles (requires sudo)
netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state.windows: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off

a1.code: sudo ufw status numbered && sudo ufw delete NUMBER

a2.code: sudo nmcli networking off && sudo nmcli networking on

a1.code: sudo ufw disable && sudo ufw default deny && sudo ufw enable

ip neigh show 192.168.1.1.description: Show ARP entry for specific IP

netsh interface ipv4 set subinterface.code: sudo ip link set eth0 mtu 1400

netsh interface ipv4 add address.code: sudo ip addr add 192.168.1.100/24 dev eth0

netsh interface ipv4 delete address.code: sudo ip addr del 192.168.1.100/24 dev eth0

dir /o-d.description: List directory sorted by date (newest first)

popd.description: Return to previous directory from stack

rmdir /s.description: Remove directory and all contents (requires caution)

copy con file.txt.description: Create file from keyboard input (Ctrl+Z to end)

attrib +h.description: Hide a file (Linux: prefix with dot)

more.description: Display file one screen at a time

type file.txt | more.description: Display file one screen at a time

sort /+n.description: Sort file starting from column n

start /wait.description: Start program and wait for completion

chkdsk.description: Check disk for errors (requires reboot for system)

net localgroup administrators username /.description: Add user to admin group (requires sudo)
Remove user from admin group (requires sudo)

net accounts /lockoutwindow:.description: Set account lockout observation window (requires sudo)
